items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: I used to know his name too... This fella, he used to, he's driving cab now, he quit music.

ctx.x: Hey, can you call any of those clarinet players there, Emmanuel? Wait, let me see now. Is that light all right for you?

It's all right. I can't touch it this one. Some of them clarinet players are mixed up. Now, here's a fella here. I don't know his name. Never did know his name. On the left. On the left there. The first one on the left, yeah? Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Now, this look like Israel Goleman. Oh, yeah, next to him, yeah. This one, this Willie Humphrey. Oh, yeah, that's Willie. Oh, yeah, Willie. Yeah, he looks young then. Mm-hmm. Now, this fella here is a bunny. Bunny? left there. The first one on the left, yeah. Now this look…

Edward Stamps, I think it is. Wait a minute, to get back to this Bundy, that wouldn't be a fella that once was a drummer, Walter Brundy. No, no, no. Brundy, who took up clarinet later. A friend of Bunk Johnson's used to talk about him. Baby Dodds, and he was older, should be older than him, I just
